column3: I wake up early every day.
She studies English before breakfast.
The bus arrives at seven.
We read short stories at school.
My brother plays soccer after class.
They cook dinner together at home.
The library opens at nine in the morning.
I usually drink coffee on cold days.
Our teacher gives us a small quiz every Friday.
The children are building a paper airplane.
I called my friend because I needed help.
We visited a museum near the river last weekend.
The weather became cloudy before the rain started.
My cousin wants to learn guitar this year.
The movie was interesting but a little too long.
I forgot my umbrella, so I got wet.
They decided to travel by train instead of plane.
The company announced a new policy for remote work.
A small mistake in the code caused a major outage.
The scientist explained the experiment in simple words.
Our team completed the project ahead of schedule.
The restaurant was crowded, so we waited outside.
She saved money for months to buy a laptop.
I wrote a long email to describe the issue clearly.
